name: investment-portfolio-workspace
description: Investment Portfolio Tracker workspace with Next.js backend and Vue.js frontend

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold" --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:clean: npm run clean --prefix backend && concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold" --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
